label: PowerFlowState
info:
Reads Power Flow State from registers:
- 166: Generator power
- 169: Grid power
- 178: Load power
- 186-189: MPPT 1-4 power
- 190: Battery power

Triggers:
1. Periodic: Every 5 minutes
2. RPC: getPowerFlowState

name: Prepare read (Gen/Grid 166-169)
Prepare read (Load/PV/Batt 178-190)
Build PowerFlowState JSON
Prepare RPC Response
